summary: fractal-ui gains ChromeControl, one quiet 28px icon button with hover fill, accent focus ring and kit tooltip. The thread header (expand sidebar, Agent, Resources, conversation menu, terminal and panel toggles), the live sidebar's collapse button and footer (theme, Missions, Usage) and the sidebar toolbar (Needs me, Filter, Sort) render it.

compatibility.detail: New kit export ChromeControl (and ChromeControlProps) from @smalltalk/fractal-ui/assistant-ui/shell; new kit icons person, checklist, gauge, filter, sort, bell. Every accessible name is unchanged, but Agent, Resources, Missions, Usage and Needs me no longer have visible text, so tests that find them by text must use the accessible name. The thread header's disabled terminal toggle loses data-testid="terminal-toggle-disabled" (its wrapper keeps the reason as title), the toggles lose their native title in favour of the tooltip, and the Resources refusal reason is no longer shown inline (it stays the button's description and hover title).
